title: nan
authors: Naanjam R.; Ebadi H.; Farnood Ahmadi F.
key_contribution: Presents a deep cross-modality geo-localization framework for UAVSAR imagery in GPS-denied environments (urban canyons, jamming) with RMSE of 1.83-2.86 m across extensive experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
